slug: 2025-10-13 Gambia Passes Landmark Data Protection and Privacy Law

facts.fact: BABL AI reports that the National Assembly passed the Personal Data Protection and Privacy Bill 2025 in its Third Ordinary Session; no assent is stated (published 2025-10-13, no other date).
facts.system: Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act 2025

facts.fact: The report says the law establishes an independent oversight Commission and that institutional mechanisms for compliance and enforcement remain to be established (published 2025-10-13, no other date).
